contentAr:
لا غبار عليهم دايما بيقفوا جنبي في أي مشكلة في الشغل ومن أنظف الناس بجد والله ليهم معزة خاصة

contentEn:
They’re beyond reproach. They always stand by me whenever a problem comes up at work, and they’re honestly some of the most upright people I know. I swear, they hold a special place in my heart.
The quality is excellent and the results look great. The only issue is that deadlines sometimes shift from what was agreed.
